title: Officials endorse a multi-generational crash retrieval program

tellings.quote: also seen past directors of the CIA, congressmen and women, and whistleblowers across agencies endorsing the existence of a decades-long, multi-generational UFO crash retrieval and reverse engineering program.

plain: Past directors of the CIA, the US spy agency, along with members of Congress and whistleblowers from several agencies, are said to have backed the idea of a secret program, running for decades and across generations, that recovers crashed UFOs and tries to copy how they work. Michels says this himself, as a summary of what he has seen, in an episode about the time he spent with Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft. If true, it would mean the claim is supported by people inside government, not only by outsiders.
